name: intend
description:
Prospective memory — 'remember to do X when Y happens.' Sets a deferred action that auto-triggers on context match.

CALL WHEN you notice something to do later:
- 'When we touch auth, check the error handling'
- 'Next time we open database.rs, add that index'
- 'When user mentions deployment, remind about the TLS cert'
- 'In 30 minutes, check if the build finished'

Trigger types: Topic (keyword match), FilePattern (file glob), Duration (minutes), Context (flexible condition).

Intentions are repo-scoped and persist across sessions. They trigger automatically when check_intentions runs. Set liberally — they cost nothing until triggered.
Cost: ~1ms.

repo.description: Repository path for scoping (defaults to server's configured repo)

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: set_foresight
description:
Time-bounded memory — declare a planned-future fact or temporary constraint with a validity window. Search surfaces it ONLY while valid at the current time; expired and not-yet-active facts are filtered out automatically, so stale deadlines never pollute context.

CALL WHEN a fact only holds for a window:
- 'Code freeze until 2026-07-01' (valid_until)
- 'Migration plan goes live on 2026-06-30' (valid_from)
- 'API v1 is deprecated as of today' (valid_until open-ended past the cutover)
- 'Use the staging cluster this week' (valid_from + valid_until)

valid_from/valid_until are optional RFC3339 timestamps; omit either for an open-ended bound. Cost: ~1ms.

session_id.description: Session UUID to scope the fact to (defaults to the current session)

valid_from.description: RFC3339 timestamp; the fact becomes active at this time (optional — omit for 'active now')

valid_until.description: RFC3339 timestamp; the fact expires at this time (optional — omit for 'no expiry')

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: check
description:
Checks pending intentions against current context. Call FREQUENTLY — at every topic change, file open, or new task start. Pass a brief description of what you're doing now as context. Returns triggered intentions you should act on.

Intentions are repo-scoped — only intentions for the current repo are checked.
Cost: ~1ms. Call often — it's free.

repo.description: Repository path (defaults to server's configured repo)

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: done
description:
Marks a triggered intention as completed.

CALL WHEN: After you have acted on a triggered intention.
Cost: ~1ms.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: intentions
description:
Lists intentions. By default lists current repo's intentions from the in-memory store.

Pass all_repos: true to list intentions across ALL repos from durable storage — useful for seeing all threads you're coordinating across projects.

CALL WHEN: User asks about pending intentions, wants a cross-project overview, or for debugging intention state.
Cost: ~1ms (in-memory), ~15ms (all_repos).

all_repos.description: If true, list intentions across ALL repos from storage (not just current session)

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: snooze
description:
Snoozes a triggered intention — resets it to pending so it can trigger again later.

CALL WHEN: An intention triggered but you want to defer action. Resets to pending state.
Cost: ~1ms.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.
